ruling: RESOLUTION (a). The hall and the flooded hall stay WINDOWLESS; bible/color_script.json is the side that moves. Both findings are ruled the same way. (-a) SCN-long-hall keeps 'no windows, no skylights' and 25 blind roundels, and lighting.json keeps roundel_glow = reflected_lamplight_only. color_script scene_curves and the act-level stained_glass doses for ep01 acts 3-6 and ep05 act 3 now carry the identical pastel dose as SURFACE colour - jewel glints and lead-came sheen on the blind roundels where a lamp hangs close, the pastel tulip lamp shades, the mosaic dado and floor border - with no pool of glass light anywhere, and the garden green through the little door left as the hall's only coloured cast light (SPC-long-hall-01). (-b) SCN-pool-of-tears has no shaft: the way-out light Alice swims toward is the field of lamp reflections at the south end, where the reflections crowd and the shore steps lie, which this scene's own lighting.json dream_growth already named; it is now recorded there as way_out_heading and written into scene_curves and the ep02 act 1 dose. SCN-courtroom is untouched - it has real high windows and keeps its cast stained-glass light, so style.json CR-007 ('daylight through stained glass MAY cast soft pastel colour... that is the only coloured light') is still satisfied and the H2-frozen style.json needed no change and no hand-off.
ruling_basis: Source text over inferred design (WRITE_RULES.md section 1): ch001-p11 'lit up by a row of lamps hanging from the roof' and ch001-p14 'that dark hall' anchor the architecture card; the roundel-window reading was inferred, unanchored, and would add an unwritten light source to a hall the source calls dark.

The later, narrower ruling on the same fact wins: roundel_glow was decided on 2026-09-23 by p4-cr-architecture / p4-cr-lighting-2 under BIB-0027 (closing DEF-p4-cr-architecture-001-b); color_script's BIB-0027 amendment was written in the same parallel batch and never re-read against the amended openings, so it is the stale side. Recorded as precedent P-014 in bible/WRITE_RULES.md.
Two scene files against one plan file for the pool: SCN-pool-of-tears inherits SCN-long-hall and already carried key_source oil_lamp_row, daylight_access lamplit_no_sky and no shaft.

Irreversibility: a window opening is architecture, not decoration. The whiteboxes and layout packs for both scenes are H2-locked at G4 (runs/g4/gate.json), ep01's storyboard is delivered against the windowless reading, and the user's auto-reroll budget is 0.

Design: the little-door garden green is the film's designed way-out colour and the one motivated bright thing ep01 act 3 is built around; a second daylight source in the hall would compete with it and a pool shaft would duplicate its job.
downstream_repass: NONE. directing/ep01/storyboard.json already implements this ruling literally (its own conflicts[] note and the director's interim direction), so ep01 S05, S06 and S10 are confirmed clean and are NOT marked dirty; no lighting re-pass and no storyboard re-cut. ep05 act 3 inherits the answer through scene_curves.
